Gorilla Technology Secures US$111 Million Convertible Note Facility to Fund Its Data-Center Pipeline

LONDON, Nov. 3, 2026 -- Gorilla Technology Group Inc. (NASDAQ: GRRR) today announced a convertible note facility of up to US$111 million with an institutional investor.

The notes carry a 4.5% coupon and convert at US$14.20 per share, a 20% premium to the last close. An initial tranche of US$40 million is expected to close on November 5, 2026.

Proceeds fund the US data-center letter of intent announced on October 9, 2026.

About Gorilla Technology Group Inc.

Headquartered in London, Gorilla is a global solution provider.
